lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Reward: Gem ×50

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Sounds like you had a successful outing!
I certainly did.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Excellent!

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: How was it? Did you feel it in your bones?
It was amazing.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: You're darn right it is!

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I'm glad to see there's someone else out there who can feel the romance and thrill of fishing.
Next time, we must go together.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I'm afraid that might be a little difficult.
Why's that?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I'm currently incarcerated.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: However, I'd be more than happy to go with you once I'm out.
What did you do?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I secretly took the Surface Elevator to reach the fishing spot,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: but they caught me in no time flat and brought me here.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Fortunately, the warden here also understands the thrill of fishing,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: so they let me use a cellphone occasionally.
That's quite a remarkable tale.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: And, dare I say, romantic, perhaps?

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Anyways,

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: you can keep that fishing rod for the time being.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: We'll go angling together

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: one of these days for sure.
Absolutely.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Until then, never lose your sense of romance.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: Well, I've gotta go. Time for roll call.
Take care of yourself.

lines.speaker: romantist
lines.text: I will!
